description.summary: This spell causes seven shimmering, multicolored beams of light to spray from your hand
description.value: This spell causes seven shimmering, multicolored beams of light to spray from your hand. Each beam has a different power. Creatures in the area of the spell with 8 HD or less are automatically blinded for 2d4 rounds. Every creature in the area is randomly struck by one or more beams, which have additional effects. 1d8 Color of Beam Effect 1 Red 20 points fire damage (Reflex half) 2 Orange 40 points earth damage (Reflex half) 3 Yellow 80 points lightning damage (Reflex half) 4 Green Poison (Frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; Init. effect death; Sec. effect 1 Con/round; Cure 2 consecutive Fort saves) 5 Blue Turned to stone, as Break spell (Fortitude negates) 6 Indigo Insane, as Insanity spell (Will negates) 7 Violet Sent to another plane, as Plane Shift spell (Will negates) 8 Struck by two rays Roll twice more, ignoring any “8” results
